name: hoster
description: Hoster — Your Local Files. Everywhere. A local-network file hosting web app and media center.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,magenta "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm install --prefix desktop && npm start --prefix desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm install --prefix desktop && npm run dist:win --prefix desktop
